ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the central position of the figure there is a positively charged nitrogen atom N+, connected at the upper left to an Ar1 substituent; below is the acyl region, containing an Ar substituent and an oxygen atom O; on the right side is a benzene ring/aryl ring, with a negative charge marked inside the ring. There are also multiple curved arrows in the figure, indicating electron redistribution of the right-side aryl negative charge, around N+, and in the acyl-O region. Reasoning: When pushing electrons according to the arrows, keep the existing σ-bond skeleton unchanged, and only change the positions of π bonds/lone-pair electrons and formal charges. After electron rearrangement, N+ and the aryl negative charge are neutralized, the acyl part returns to a neutral carbonyl C=O, and nitrogen becomes a neutral tertiary amide nitrogen. The final structure is a neutral tertiary benzamide: the carbonyl carbon is connected to one phenyl group, and nitrogen is connected to two phenyl groups. Therefore the corresponding SMILES is O=C(N(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2)c3ccccc3.

raw_record.question_text: An 'arrow-pushing' diagram is a common type of chemical image used to illustrate electron flow in mechanistic steps. Please choose the SMILES expression for the molecules(state) after the electron has been relocated, as depicted in the image. <image_1>

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the N+ center, the O in the acyl region, the Ar/Ar1 substituents, the right phenyl ring with a negative charge, and the curved arrows indicating electron relocation. Apply the arrows sequentially to move the π/lone-pair electrons into the neutral carbonyl-amide arrangement. Keep the sigma-bond skeleton fixed while changing bond orders and charges. The resulting molecule is the neutral tertiary benzamide with one phenyl on the carbonyl carbon and two phenyl groups on nitrogen; write it as O=C(N(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2)c3ccccc3.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中中心位置有一个带正电荷的氮原子 N+，左上连接 Ar1 取代基；下方是酰基区域，含有 Ar 取代基和一个氧原子 O；右侧是一个苯环/芳基环，环内标有负电荷。图中还有多条弯箭头，表示右侧芳基负电荷、N+ 周围以及酰基-O 区域的电子重新分布。推理：按照箭头推动电子时，保持已有 σ 键骨架不变，只改变 π 键/孤对电子位置和形式电荷。电子重排后，N+ 与芳基负电荷被中和，酰基部分恢复为中性羰基 C=O，氮成为中性的三级酰胺氮。最终结构是一个中性三级苯甲酰胺：羰基碳连接一个苯基，氮连接两个苯基。因此对应 SMILES 为 O=C(N(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2)c3ccccc3。
